scope: Browser native Codex/Claude subscription login, constrained root operator, managed runner provisioning, workspace bind anchors and lease-authorized restart lifecycle. Subsequent model-catalog additions are reviewed separately.
verdict: No blocking source findings remain after actual Claude Opus 5.5 anchor closure; the required final isolated VM anchor/login integration passed. This does not claim human provider login or model inference.

acceptedFindings.problem: Visited-project workers could retain global capacity and cached pending jobs indefinitely.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Idle workers expire; job deadlines and heartbeat terminal-state refresh bound ownership. Project operations serialize worker creation and bound queued requests.

acceptedFindings.problem: Native command chains and inherited pipes could exceed control deadlines or pin shutdown.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Status/command budgets are bounded; cleanup destroys held streams after a hard deadline; same-process-group descendants are killed. Logout checks its target and keeps other status cached.

acceptedFindings.problem: Warnings on stderr could corrupt Claude JSON status.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Parse stdout separately while maintaining a shared output byte budget.

acceptedFindings.problem: Missing operator configuration and missing operations were mapped to generic failures.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Preserve sanitized error codes and clear stale provider challenges; missing configuration can be reconstructed through a new explicit connection.

acceptedFindings.problem: Provisioning could exceed the outer deadline or treat a single running observation as readiness.
acceptedFindings.resolution: One overall preparation budget and repeated stable boot observations precede success; isolated VM test uses stable readiness after restore.

acceptedFindings.problem: A Hub-writable source path could be replaced between validation and Docker bind resolution.
acceptedFindings.resolution: A fixed root helper enters the host mount namespace, opens parent/child with NOFOLLOW, and duplicates the held source FD into mount as FD3. Docker uses only a protected stable anchor; inode identity is checked before starting agents.

acceptedFindings.problem: Helper timeout could leave an unowned mount child or a partially configured mount.
acceptedFindings.resolution: One outer process group includes helper and mount children, inner deadlines leave rollback time, source is /proc/self/fd/3, new failed mounts get rollback, and existing anchors also receive make-private.

acceptedFindings.problem: Docker automatic restart could use an un-restored anchor after reboot.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Managed restart policy is no. Root-owned saved metadata plus live lease authority restore the anchor before starting; Supervisor validates device/inode. Atomic per-file configuration writes are cross-checked for consistency.

acceptedFindings.problem: A fixed first-32 batch never restored later projects.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Rotate the sorted project batch cursor; a 40-project regression proves eventual coverage.

acceptedFindings.problem: External workspace replacement failed with a generic unavailable error.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Keep identity changes fail-closed, report workspace_identity_changed HTTP409, and document explicit administrator maintenance without deleting private homes or project data.

acceptedFindings.problem: A writable ancestor could rename a root-owned anchor directory.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Require root-owned non-writable ancestors for state, release source, helper and runtime. Service-owned subdirectories retain their UID and are individually mounted.

rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.advice: Bind a private operator namespace FD through /proc/operatorPID/fd after switching only the mount child to the host namespace.
rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.disposition: Rejected. Linux bind mount namespace ownership checks require source opening in the host namespace. The fixed helper switches namespace/root before opening.

rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.advice: Use /proc/operatorPID/fd directly as a persistent Docker bind source.
rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.disposition: Rejected. Saved Docker config would depend on a process/FD lifetime. Stable root-protected anchors survive operator restarts.

rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.advice: Automatically unmount and trust a new workspace inode during ordinary reconnect.
rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.disposition: Qualified and not implemented. Public project APIs only set rootPath at creation; replacement is explicit administrator maintenance and stays fail-closed.

rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.advice: Require a fresh passkey again when completing an already-started native challenge after five minutes.
rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.disposition: Not adopted. Start is fresh-passkey protected; bounded continuation is bound to the original live human session, operation owner and current administrator authority. A second reauthentication rotates the session and would strand the challenge.

rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.advice: The UI presents API key authentication as a subscription.
rejectedOrQualifiedAdvice.disposition: Rejected by source and regression: ProviderLogin renders API-Schlüssel eingerichtet separately; the subsequent actual closeout recognized the correction.

preservedRequirements: No Docker socket in the Hub; only a fixed authenticated narrow Unix operator protocol reaches host-root actions.
Provider credentials remain in the private native Runner home. Browser receives structured challenges/status, never raw native stdout or persistent provider tokens.
Commands, paths, images and privilege drop are fixed; requesters cannot supply shell commands or arbitrary filesystem destinations.
Login ownership and live original-session/project/profile/lease checks remain enforced.
Existing provider homes and project files survive reconnect, recovery and normal updates.

primarySources.claim: --no-canonicalize disables userspace path canonicalization for descriptor-based bind sources.
__do_loopback checks source mount namespace ownership; source FDs must be opened in the host namespace used for the bind.
Managed restart:no lets the operator restore and authorize anchors before containers restart.

postReviewChanges.scope: Native model discovery and picker integration
postReviewChanges.change: Subsequent source changes are evaluated by the separate native model catalog review record; they are not claimed as part of this earlier login/anchor snapshot.

limits: Anonymous native challenge flows were tested; no real human provider consent, subscription use or model inference was performed.
The VM test used isolated accounts, homes, containers and networks; no human credentials were inspected.
Same-group process cleanup and bounded escaped-pipe handling are verified; no promise to terminate arbitrary unrelated process groups is made.
Root release trees must be installed fully root-owned. Per-file atomicity does not imply a two-file transaction; inconsistency blocks automatic restoration.
Raw prompts/replies stay outside the repository. This sanitized record includes metadata, source hashes and dispositions only.
